hypothesis: The availability check in formatInventoryInput compares each cart line's needed units (required_quantity times quantity) against the location's availability independently, so lines that share the WIDGET inventory item are never added together. One cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 needs 12 WIDGET units against 10 stocked. If the per-line check is the only guard, the order is created with 12 units reserved, which breaks no_oversell. If the reservation step rejects it, the completion should fail and no order is left behind, so the check should pass.

name: shared-item-lines-one-cart
description: One cart has two lines on the shared WIDGET item whose combined units exceed stock.

  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 1

  WIDGET: 10

    lines:

    - sku: OVS-TWOPACK
